description: This file defines the SerializationConstructorFactory class, which creates delegates for calling ISerializable-conformant constructors, utilizing reflection and dynamic method generation.

classes.name: SerializationConstructorFactory
classes.description: Creates delegates for calling ISerializable-conformant constructors, managing constructor invocations via reflection and dynamic method emission.

methods.name: HasSerializationConstructor
methods.description: Checks if a given type has a serialization constructor.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate
methods.description: Returns a delegate for the serialization constructor of a specified type.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate<TOwner, TConstructor>
methods.description: Generic method to get a serialization constructor delegate for specified owner and delegate types.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorDelegate
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a constructor delegate for a given owner type and delegate type.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructor
methods.description: Retrieves the ConstructorInfo for the serialization constructor of a given type.

methods.name: GetSerializationConstructorInvoker
methods.description: Creates a delegate that invokes the serialization constructor via emitted IL code.
